manual_checklist.one_defensible_answer: Reviewed each choice and excerpt; excerpt portions have an explicit scope and each violation has direct evidence.
manual_checklist.distractors: Common errors grounded in glossary facts; glossary misconception arrays were empty. Every wrong option has why-wrong feedback.
manual_checklist.taught_before_tested: Stage strict gate passed all measured facts; video-only and future facts are not added.
manual_checklist.practice_success: Inspect-and-judge groups cover the full success workflow plus concrete traps. Python returns all matched counts, rates, costs, requirement outcomes and frozen identities for base and both empty-class cohorts.
manual_checklist.allowed_syntax_conflict: Python task narrowed to learner-written NumPy sums of every supplied confusion mask; function/control-flow scaffolding retained because glossary descriptors have no syntax detectors. Constraints copied verbatim.
manual_checklist.data_keys: No asset answer values authored. Python expected values obtained by executing the pinned runner. Inspect excerpts are authored proposed actions, not invented execution observations.
manual_checklist.starter_and_mutations: Stage gate verifies starter does not pass and derives data-dependent hidden checks.
manual_checklist.output_contract: Python prompt names each graded variable, dictionary key and cohort.
manual_checklist.schema_and_plan: All four requested tiles, exactly one planned interaction per check/hands_on; no new steps.
